description:
`clmul_wide<const N: usize>` — schoolbook GF(2)-polynomial multiplication of two `[u64; N]` operands into `[u64; 2*N]`. Task 2 of the 6fb4abad breakdown.

## Scope

- `fn clmul_wide<const N: usize>(a: &[u64; N], b: &[u64; N]) -> [u64; 2*N]` in `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide.rs`.
  - Pure safe Rust. Inner word-word clmul uses `barrett::clmul(u64, u64) -> u128` (or a local copy).
  - O(N²) schoolbook. For each `(i, j)` accumulate `a[i] * b[j]` into `out[i+j]` / `out[i+j+1]`.
- **Rust 1.80 MSRV caveat**: `[u64; 2*N]` as return type may not compile. Use one of: (a) a `const M: usize` second parameter with `const _: () = assert!(M == 2*N);`, or (c) out-parameter `&mut [u64; 2*N]`. Pick (a) or (c); no new deps. Document the choice.

## Success criteria

- Unit tests with known vectors: `(1)*(1) = 1`, `(x)*(x) = x^2`, `(x+1)*(x+1) = x^2+1`, all-ones squared.
- Cross-check for `N=2` (128-bit operands): result matches `u128`-based reference built on `barrett::clmul`.
- Proptest (≤128 cases): `clmul_wide(a, b) == clmul_wide(b, a)`.
- `cargo fmt`/`cargo clippy -- -D warnings`/`cargo test --release` clean.

## Depends on

Task 1 of 6fb4abad (type shell).
